headline: Viper Energy Exceeds Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
summary: Viper Energy reported third-quarter earnings that surpassed analyst expectations by $0.95, while revenue also came in above estimates.
why: Viper Energy owns mineral and royalty interests in oil and natural gas properties, providing investors with leveraged exposure to upstream energy production.

impacts.name: Viper Energy Inc
impacts.why: Beating both earnings and revenue expectations typically drives positive sentiment and share price appreciation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
